question: On large-cap bounce (3-down-close) setups, does a bigger capitulation volume spike (higher rvol50) produce a better subsequent long stop-R than a quiet volume bounce? Expect the top rvol50 quartile to have the best avg_stop_r, monotone across buckets.
plain: Tests whether large-cap dip-buys work better when the down-move happened on heavy volume (real capitulation/panic) vs on light, boring volume.
